blockingFindings.description: Direct review of all five regenerated views shows pointed lavender band ends/projections still visible at hem corners although the trim is now an explicit miter-joined quad mesh. The geometric band change did not resolve the silhouette.

Direct review of the armature-path trial, with overskirt excluded from cloth bake, still shows repeated narrow ridges and uneven side/rear surfaces. This localizes the corrugation to authored/rest mesh or pose rendering rather than the cloth solver.

Crouch and sit retain lifted/folded overskirt with under-shorts exposed; prone is visibly distorted. Avatar fit, final rig weights and shape-key coverage, Unity/VRChat runtime, UV validation, and package eligibility remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
